name: Waxed Field Jacket
description: A rugged waxed-cotton canvas field jacket with a soft corduroy collar, brass snap-front placket, and bellows pockets, built for changeable outdoor weather.
materials: Waxed cotton canvas shell, corduroy collar, brass snap hardware, cotton-twill lining
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, logo, wordmark, or printed/embossed marking anywhere on the jacket; never add extra pockets, zippers, or hardware beyond the described brass-snap placket and bellows pockets; never change the brass hardware to another metal finish; keep any interior label completely blank and unprinted. Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: Keep the exact silhouette, deep olive-green wax finish, tan corduroy collar, and brass snap placket identical and consistent across every angle; fabric texture, color saturation, and hardware finish must match exactly from front to back to detail to on-form.
